headline: Midtjylland are favourites, but St. Truiden create the better chances
summary: Midtjylland beat Viborg 2-1 in Monday's Jutland derby and are five games unbeaten, so the market makes them 56.7% favourites against St. Truiden — nearly three times the Belgians' 19.7%. Look closer and the run is thinner than the results: the derby brought only 0.84 expected goals, and Ekstra Bladet reports the injury problems continue, though Bak is back. St. Truiden lost three league games in a row before two wins, yet they average 1.48 expected goals a game — more than Midtjylland's 1.25. The handicap rates the Danes 0.75 goals better.
read: Midtjylland are clear favourites at about 57% to St. Truiden's 20% and rated roughly 0.8 goals the better side, arriving unbeaten in five after Monday's Jutland derby win. The Belgians have won their last two in cup and Europe but lost three straight league games before that, and the market leans just under three goals on a line of 3.0.

facts.fact: Midtjylland are priced at 56.7% to win, against St. Truiden's 19.7%.
facts.meaning: The home side is rated nearly three times more likely to take the three points than the Belgians.

facts.fact: Midtjylland won 2-1 at Viborg in the Jutland derby on Monday and are level on points with FC Copenhagen at the top of the Superliga.
facts.meaning: They arrive with derby momentum, but on a short turnaround after a derby that costs legs.

facts.fact: St. Truiden's last five read WWLLL — three league defeats in a row before back-to-back wins in the Belgian cup and in Europe.
facts.meaning: The Belgian side is in better mood than a fortnight ago, but that league run is why they arrive as clear underdogs.

facts.fact: The Asian handicap is set at Midtjylland -0.75, with the fair line at -0.80.
facts.meaning: The market rates Midtjylland about 0.8 goals the better team — a one-goal home win only half-settles the handicap.

facts.fact: Midtjylland were out-created in the derby, 0.84 xG to Viborg's 1.56.
facts.meaning: Their results have been slightly better than the chances they have created — the win came with little control.

facts.fact: St. Truiden have averaged 1.48 xG across their last five matches, more than Midtjylland's 1.25.
facts.meaning: The underdog creates the better chances of the two sides — the gap in the price is bigger than the gap in chance quality.

facts.fact: Ekstra Bladet reported on Wednesday evening that Midtjylland's injury problems continue and that coach Mike Tullberg gave largely bad news at his press conference, though Bak is back.
facts.meaning: The home squad is not at full strength on the eve of the tie, with one player returning rather than a clean bill of health.

facts.fact: Over 3.0 goals is priced at 48.4%, leaving the market leaning just under three goals.
facts.meaning: A game with goals, but not an open one by expectation — the goal line sits right on three.

sources.fact: FC Midtjylland beat bitter rivals Viborg 2-1 in the Jutland derby on Monday and moved level on points with FC Copenhagen at the top of the Danish Superliga.
Ekstra Bladet reports that FC Midtjylland's injury problems continue, with Mike Tullberg giving largely bad news at Wednesday's press conference before the St. Truiden match, though Bak is back.
FC Midtjylland drew 1-1 away to Egnatia in Albania in their first Conference League league-phase match.
Rasmus Nissen Kristensen called Philip Billing the best player in the Superliga after the 2-1 win over Viborg.
Teenage Danish-Nigerian forward Julius Emefile has signed a contract extension with FC Midtjylland until the end of 2031 after a hat-trick in a cup game.
Sint-Truiden are described as being set for their historic European debut campaign, with this Conference League tie at Midtjylland among their first group-stage matches.
Taiga Hata is named as part of the St. Truiden (STVV) squad visiting Midtjylland in the Conference League.
